name: The Scroll Of Truth
meaning: An explorer finds the Scroll of Truth after 15 years, reads it, and angrily throws it away. For an uncomfortable truth people refuse to accept.
when_to_use: left = the uncomfortable truth written on the scroll (bottom left panel). right = optional label at the bottom of the last panel, where he throws it away.
baked_in_text: The image already has the speech bubbles "I'VE FINALLY FOUND IT... AFTER 15 YEARS", "THE SCROLL OF TRUTH!" and "NYEHHH". Only write the truth on the scroll.
